limitations: CAD is the manufacturer linked base Zero mechanical file. Do not apply its FH4R2 identity to the independently sold N8R8 option.
No editable PCB stack, RF behaviour or production fit certification is implied.
PCB photograph is registered to the nominal 18 x 23.5 mm board rectangle; slight perspective and photo/CAD differences remain. Native chip and USB geometry is not stretched to fit it.
BOOT and RGB body locations are matched to the official component photograph; RESET is geometry only and uses the platform reset action.
CAD materials and dimensions are retained with explicitly photo-based color overrides; no measured optical material is claimed.
Header count/centers are source-backed; body and pin dimensions including hidden insertion length remain unmeasured estimates. No physical mating guarantee.
This is a new Zero-M reconstruction from the retained original CAD. The original published Zero asset directory is unchanged.
The exact-M reference demonstrates soldered headers, but no manufacturer header CAD/hidden insertion-depth specification was located.
